title: Add BC performance knowledge from OptimAL learnings
summary: Added six new performance guidance articles with code examples and refined existing guidance on indexing, buffered inserts, aggregate processing, and FlowField caching based on the OptimAL Performance Initiative.
key_points: Six new knowledge articles covering workload-based indexes, overlapping indexes, buffered inserts, aggregate-before-write processing, scoped result caching, and repeated validation avoidance
Each new article includes paired good and bad AL code examples demonstrating best practices
Refinements to existing performance guidance on partial loads, temporary buffers, bulk updates, existence checks, primary-key caching, and SIFT-specific SetCurrentKey behavior
Performance-review skill extended to evaluate against the new rules
All examples are generalized from OptimAL learnings without partner or customer-specific information
